chapter_title_en: The Summoning of the Ancestral Dragon Ship
chapter_seo_title: Eleven Dragon Kings Summon the Ancestral Ship | World of Immortality Chapter 116
chapter_meta_description: The eleven Companion Dragon Kings roar in unison to summon the Ancestral Dragon Ship across the Forbidden Sea. Lan Nuo brokers peace, and Keke leads the kings in a sacred ritual. A bittersweet departure from Dragon Island.
og_title: The Dragon Kings' Call: Departure from Dragon Island
og_description: Xiao Chen and the cultivators prepare to leave Dragon Island as eleven dragon kings collectively summon the legendary ship. Lan Nuo mediates between enemies, and Keke takes center stage in a mythic farewell.
twitter_title: Ancestral Ship Appears as Dragon Kings Roar
twitter_description: The long-awaited departure begins: eleven companion dragon kings roar, Keke leads them, and the Ancestral Dragon Ship emerges from the forbidden sea. A chapter of farewell and awe.
